outcome: number of patients released to home care
number of days after admission when delivery occurred
cohort: The study included critically ill pregnant COVID-19 patients admitted to the intensive care unit of Elena Doamna Obstetrics and Gynecology University Hospital in Iasi between 1 January and 1 December 2021.
finding: There was no significant difference in maternal and fetal outcomes between critical COVID-19 patients infected with the Alpha versus Delta variants, except for the number of patients released to home care and the number of days after admission when delivery occurred.
